resources.string: Never translate these (one per line), or choose a translation: thread = 執行緒
Remember translations on this phone, so the same text is not sent again (turning this off deletes them)
Hide translations while the page scrolls, show them when it stops (easier on the eyes)
Text was read but not translated: Google is refusing requests from this phone for now, and the offline model is not available. Download the language in the app, or wait.
Text was read but not translated: cannot reach Google (check the internet), and the offline model is not available.
Text was read but not translated: the offline translation failed. %1$s
Gemini API key (tried before Google; leave empty to not use it)
Where to get one: 1) tap the button below and sign in with a Google account, 2) tap "Create API key", 3) copy the key and paste it above. It is free to start. The text goes to Google under your key.
Gemini did not translate, so Google or offline is used: %1$s
Use Google Translate first (sends the text to Google; offline translation is the backup)
Speech (list what is heard at the bottom)
Use the microphone even while the screen is shared (on its own, speech always uses the microphone)
Microphone permission is needed for speech
Choose screen text, speech, or both
Could not check for updates (no connection to GitHub)
Screen Translator is up to date
Screen Translator %1$s%2$s is available. Download it now? Android will ask you to confirm the install.
Allow installs from Screen Translator, then tap \"Check for updates\" again
Allow \"Display over other apps\", then press Start again
Speech translation needs an offline speech model (about %1$d MB, downloaded once). It hears every language and detects which one is spoken. How do you want to download?
The speech model is needed for speech translation
Offline translation needs: %1$s (about 30 MB each, downloaded once). How do you want to download?
Tap Stop to turn translation off
What the phone plays (videos, calls, streams)
Hearing what the phone plays needs screen sharing (an Android rule): you are asked once when speech translation starts. The screen itself is only translated if you also start screen translation.
No sound from the phone. Is something playing? Some apps do not allow their sound to be recorded.
Fast: words appear while they are spoken
Accurate: a whole sentence at a time
Fast needs a small extra model (English 72 MB, Chinese 200 MB, Korean 132 MB, Japanese/Vietnamese/Indonesian 340 MB). With "Detect automatically", and for other languages, the accurate way is used.
Fast captions need a speech model for this language (about %1$d MB, downloaded once). How do you want to download?
DeepL API key (tried after Gemini, before Google; leave empty to not use it)
DeepL did not translate, so Google or offline is used: %1$s
Game / video mode: look at the screen faster (use with a chosen region)
Drag a rectangle around the text to translate
Start translating first, then choose the region.
Replace the original text with its translation (lined up left / centre / right like the original)
